episode.title: A 27-Metre Ship Was Buried As A Royal Grave

synopsis: An Anglo-Saxon royal burial in England placed a 27-metre wooden ship inside an earthen mound.

title_card.title: A 27-metre ship was buried.
title_card.subtitle: Ancient Anglo Saxons used it as a tomb.

caption:
In England, a 27-metre ship was buried in a grassy field as a royal grave.

Excavations at Sutton Hoo in 1939 revealed the intact timber outline of an Anglo-Saxon burial vessel. The ship contained rich grave goods intended for a 7th-century ruler.

Visuals created with AI.

Would you want a giant ship as your grave?
